data.name: The Silent Front: World War Ⅱ
data.detailed_description:
Do you ever dream about rewriting history?

What if this is already the version of history shaped by countless others?

This is a grounded spy-themed adventure game set on the European front of World War II. As a double agent secretly trained by Britain from childhood and later embedded within the German military, you traverse Germany, Spain, America, and Britain from 1939 to 1945, caught between factions and fighting to stay alive through intel exchange, surveillance, infiltration, identity shifts and strategic relationships.

· A Realistic World War II Spy Experience

Rooted in real historical events, the story focuses on intelligence work, covert operations, and multi-faction power struggles. No exaggerated super-spy tropes, only the risks and brutality of espionage in wartime.

· Difficult Choices Beyond Judging People

Colleagues, superiors, allies, lovers, informants, enemy agents... every interaction is a calculated game. Trust is the one thing least to be given on the battlefield. Who deserves it, and who will you ultimately betray? Are you faithful to your side, or to your conscience? Your perception of others will directly influence what happens next and how the story unfolds.

· History & Personal Fate Intertwine

From the invasion of Poland to the Battle of Britain and Operation Barbarossa, you'll move through the cracks of real historical events, witnessing how an ordinary person is forced to make costly decisions under the shadow of war.

· Multi-Layered Espionage

Eavesdrop, steal, rendezvous, deliver, verify, disguise, and destroy evidence—you must prioritize your actions under time pressure, weigh each task's importance, and leave no trace behind.

· Strict Logic & Fully Realized Outcomes

The game features numerous branching endings driven by a rigorous chain of logic—every decision carries consequences, and any piece of intelligence could be the one that breaks you.

One misstep can lead you into a brutal Bad End. They are not simple failure screens, but fully realized standalone chapters featuring betrayal, exposure, interrogation, and execution. War shows no mercy, no matter who you are...

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The start of the war is beyond your control.

You cannot save everyone.

This is a silent war, for those whose names history may never remember, for the efforts made in pursuit of peace. All you can do is survive, complete your mission, and bear the cost of your choices.

data.short_description: In 1939, just before graduating from a German military academy, your true infiltration begins. You are Britain's hidden asset codenamed DEEP. Spying, deciphering, and moving through the shadows, you navigate rival factions, where every choice shapes your fate, your homeland, and peace.
data.supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese
